findings.description:
KilimAuction._claim(address,uint256,address) (src/KilimAuction.sol#152-178) has external calls inside a loop: collection.mintSymbols(to,bidder,firstIds[i],counts[i]) (src/KilimAuction.sol#175)
	Calls stack containing the loop:
		KilimAuction.claimSymbols(uint256,address)

Reentrancy in EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#236-249):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#242-248)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- refundLiability += amount (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#246)
	- refunds[bidder] += amount (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#245)

Reentrancy in KilimAuction.deliverPrize() (src/KilimAuction.sol#203-209):
	External calls:
	- collection.mintMasterpiece(winner) (src/KilimAuction.sol#207)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- PrizeClaimed(winner,winner) (src/KilimAuction.sol#208)

Reentrancy in EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#236-249):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#242-248)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- RefundDeferred(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#247)
	- RefundPaid(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#243)

EnglishAuction._register(address) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#135-144) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < startsAt || registrationCount >= REGISTRATION_TARGET (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#136)

EnglishAuction.settle() (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#166-174) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < endsAt (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#169)

EnglishAuction.constructor(EnglishAuction.AuctionConfig) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#93-109) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- config.treasury == address(0) || config.treasury == address(this) || config.startsAt <= block.timestamp || config.duration == 0 || config.duration > 2592000 || config.extensionWindow == 0 || config.extensionWindow > config.duration || config.incrementBps == 0 || config.incrementBps > MAX_BPS || config.reservePrice != REGISTRATION_BALANCE (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#97-101)

EnglishAuction.registerFor(address,uint256,bytes) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#120-129) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp > deadline (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#121)

EnglishAuction._handleBid(uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#200-227) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- settled || block.timestamp < startsAt || (started && block.timestamp >= endsAt) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#205)
	- extended > endsAt (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#225)

	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#202-204)
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#210-213)
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#238-240)

KilimRenderer._artworkBound(uint16[],uint256,uint256,bytes32,uint256) (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#551-580) uses assembly
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#570-572)
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#574-576)

KilimRenderer._artworkDefs(uint256,uint16[],uint256) (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#583-604) uses assembly
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#592-594)
	- INLINE ASM (src/render/KilimRenderer.sol#596-598)
